title: Good Night
label: ch:ta-good-night
canDo: I can say good night in Tamil out of roots I already own, and trace every one of those forms back to நல்.

payoff.summary: Say nalla iravu and iravu vaṇakkam, run nal- forward into nalam, naṉṟi and nalla, say which shared Sanskrit good-night phrase Tamil does without, then read நான் and say where the ா sign sits.
payoff.note: TA-C25-goodnight-alternatives is the chapter's last lesson and assesses all five atoms it introduces: iṉiya iravu and the śubha rātri pattern it breaks (TA-C25-iniya-iravu), the ா sign and நான் (TA-W10-read-naan, now a prerequisite), and the nal- alternatives. This replaces the earlier note recording the drop to 2/5 when TA-W10 joined the chapter.
